string-array.name: roast_level2_lines
string-array.item: Five minutes over. Your phone is not going anywhere, but your day is.
Still here? The app will survive without you.
Your thumb deserves a break even if you don\'t.
Scrolling won\'t finish your homework.
You set the limit yourself. Remember?
The feed is endless. Your time isn\'t.
Put it down before it puts you down.
Nothing new here. Go live a little.

string-array.name: roast_level3_lines
string-array.item: Time\'s up. Put the phone down. Now.
Still scrolling? Is your work done yet?
Your thumb works harder than you do.
Nothing new down there. Just your time disappearing.
Battery\'s full. Your future isn\'t.
You said five more minutes. How many times now?
The screen doesn\'t love you back. Let it go.
That\'s enough. Go do something useful.

string-array.name: roast_persona_strict_lines
string-array.item: Five minutes over. Your phone is not going anywhere, but your day is.
You set this limit yourself. Stick to it.
Stop making excuses and close the app now.
Discipline means putting it down even when you want one more scroll.
Every extra minute here is a minute stolen from your goals.
Lock the screen and get back to work.

string-array.name: roast_persona_sarcastic_lines
string-array.item: Oh look, still scrolling. Did you find the end of the internet yet?
Your thumb is getting a better workout than your brain today.
Breaking news: the feed will still be boring tomorrow.
I\'m sure that 47th short video was life-changing.
Congrats on ignoring your own timer again.
The app won\'t miss you, I promise.

string-array.name: roast_persona_mom_lines
string-array.item: Are you still staring at that screen? Your eyes are going to hurt!
You said just five more minutes half an hour ago!
Go drink some water and rest your eyes right now.
Your homework isn\'t going to finish itself while you\'re on your phone.
Put the phone down before I take it away myself.
Why do you even set a timer if you never listen to it?
